December 16 37.

Richard P. Butrick, Esq.,
U. S. Consul.

Dear Sir,

President's Speech.
Movietone News No.8, Vol.20.

In regard to the above and your telephone
request, I send herewith a copy of the original report
to me which I approved, a copy of a letter received
from Mr. R.K. Butler and a copy of my reply thereto.
Also a copy of report on "Universal News No.604, V.9"
from which the same speech was ordered to be deleted
without any objection having been raised by the manager
of the Nanking Theatre or the local representative of
Universal Pictures Corporation.

I also enclose a nominal roll of the Settlement
and French Concession Board of Film Censors.

All managers know they have the right of appeal
to the full board. It is seldom that this right is
claimed.

The Commissioner of Police, in the interests of
peace and good order, has the right of veto over the
Board's findings. This right has not, I think, ever
been used.

The view I take is that a speech made from a
national view point in one country to a mainly sympathetic

1937年12月16日。

Richard P. Butrick 先生，

尊敬的先生：

关于总统演讲。
《福克斯有声新闻》第8号，第20卷。

就上述事项及您的电话请求，现随函附上我批准的原始报告副本一份、收到 R.K. Butler 先生的信件副本一份以及我给他的回复副本一份。另附上关于《环球新闻》第604号，第9卷的报告副本，该新闻片中的同一篇演讲被下令删除，南京大戏院经理或环球影业公司当地代表均未提出异议。

我还附上公共租界和法租界电影审查委员会成员名单。

所有经理都知道他们有权向全体委员会提出上诉。但很少有人行使这一权利。

出于维护和平与良好秩序的利益，警务处处长有权否决委员会的裁决。我认为，这项权力从未被使用过。

我的观点是，在一个国家内从国家角度发表、主要面向同情者听众的演讲，并不适合本国这样一个情绪高涨、各国成员必须和睦共处的混合国际社区，从和平与良好秩序的角度来看是不适宜的。

1937, I regret that owing to the local situation, I do
not consider it advisable to give local prominence to

local significance and is best omitted at this time.

Yours faithfully,

Cinema Films Censored.

The undermentioned cinema film was previewed
and approved for public exhibition locally by Sub-Inspector
Riegert, G.M.P., and D.S.I. Logan, S.M.P., at the Metropol
Theatre, 500 Yu Ya Ching Road, on December 1st, 1937 :-

"Universal News No.604, V.9"

From the above newsreel, the Police Censors ordered
the deletion of approximately 250 feet of film showing
President Roosevelt making a speech at Chicago which was
directed against Italy in Abyssinia and Japan in China
and dialogue : "Without naming any nation as responsible,
the Chief Executive finds a threat in present attacks from
the air on civilians, and ships attacked and sunk by submarines
in time of peace and without cause or notice. Gravely, the
President asserts that if such things can happen in other
parts of the world, America cannot feel secure for long.
Universal Newsreel presents the President's speech as a
historic document, and gives with it a dramatic view of
incidents of aggression which called forth Mr. Roosevelt's
impassioned warning".

page_data.en:
PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT WARNS NATIONS OF NEW WORLD WAR!

The high hopes and aspirations expressed in the Briand-Kellogg
Pact and the hopes of peace that raised, have of late given way
to a haunting fear of calamity. The present reign of terror
and international lawlessness began a few years ago. It began
through unjustified interference in the internal affairs of
other nations, or the invasion of alien territory in violation
of treaties. It has now reached the stage where the very
foundations of civilization are seriously threatened. The land
marks and traditions which have marked the progress of civilization
and which mark the condition of war and order and justification,
are being slowly wiped away, without a declaration of war and
without warning or justification of any kind. Civilians, including
vast numbers of women and children are being ruthlessly
murdered with bombs from the air. In times of so called peace,
ships are being attacked and sunk by submarines without cause
or notice. Nations are fomenting and taking sides in civil war
fare, in nations that have never done them any harm. If those
things come to pass in other parts of the world, let no one
imagine that America will escape, that America may expect mercy,
that this western hemisphere will not be attacked, and that it
will continue thankfully and peacefully to carry on the ethics
of the arts of civilization. The peace loving nations must make
a concerted effort in opposition to those violating national
treaties, and those ignoring the humane instincts which today are
creating a state of international anarchy, international instability
from which there is no escape through mere isolation or
neutrality. It is my determination to pursue a policy of peace.
It is my determination to adopt every practicable measure to avoid
involvement in war. It ought to be inconceivable that in this
modern era and in the face of experience any nation could be
so foolish and ruthless as to run the risk of plunging the whole
world into war by invading and violating in contravention of
treaties with territory of other nations that have done them no
real harm and are too weak to protect themselves adequately. Yet
the peace of the world and the welfare and security of every
nation including our own, is today being threatened by that very
thing. If we are determined to keep out of war, yet we cannot
insure ourselves against the disastrous effects of war and the
dangers of involvement. America hates war, America hopes for
peace, therefore, America actively engages in the search for
peace.
page_data.zh:
罗斯福总统警告各国警惕新的世界大战！

《白里安-凯洛格公约》所表达的高度希望和抱负，以及由此产生的和平希望，最近已被一种对灾难的挥之不去的恐惧所取代。目前的恐怖统治和国际无法无天状态始于几年前。它始于对他国内政的无理干涉，或违反条约入侵他国领土。现在已达到严重威胁文明基础的地步。标志着文明进步、以及战争、秩序和正当性状况的里程碑和传统，正被慢慢抹去，没有宣战，没有任何形式的警告或正当理由。包括大量妇女和儿童在内的平民正遭到空中炸弹的无情屠杀。在所谓的和平时期，船只在毫无原因或警告的情况下遭到潜艇攻击和击沉。各国在未受其害的国家煽动并参与内战。如果这些事情在世界其他地方发生，不要以为美国能幸免，不要以为美国会得到宽恕，不要以为西半球不会受到攻击，也不要以为它能继续感激并和平地奉行文明艺术的伦理。爱好和平的国家必须共同努力，反对那些违反国家条约、无视人道本能的人，这些行为今天正在造成一种国际无政府状态和国际不稳定，仅靠孤立或中立是无法逃脱的。我决心推行和平政策。我决心采取一切可行措施避免卷入战争。在这个现代时代，面对经验教训，任何国家竟如此愚蠢和残忍，冒着将整个世界拖入战争的风险，违反条约入侵和侵犯未对其造成真正伤害且无力充分自卫的他国领土，这应该是不可想象的。然而，世界和平以及包括我国在内的每个国家的福利和安全，今天正受到这种行为的威胁。如果我们决心不参战，但我们不能保证自己免受战争的灾难性后果和卷入危险的影响。美国厌恶战争，美国希望和平，因此，美国积极参与寻求和平。

page_data.en:
Shanghai And Mr. Roosevelt
PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT is evidently a
dangerous character, by Shanghai stand-
ards.
His personality must have plenty of latent
dynamite in it and his thinking must comprise
some genuinely "dangerous thoughts."
For our police have banned his appearance
in a newsreel showing him in the act of de-
livering his historic pronouncement on inter-
national trends at Chicago—and American
Consul-General Gauss has met an appeal for
assistance in opposing this decision, repugnant
to Shanghai Americans, with the reply that he
does not feel he can intervene.
The President spoke for peace. Perhaps
that is regarded as inflammatory. He struck
out against international lawlessness. Perhaps
that is against the law as interpreted in
Shanghai. He spoke the hatred of his country
for war. Perhaps we all ought to join hands
in suppressing American notions of that de-
scription, especially as they have wickedly
permeated Britain and many other countries.
Those things may all be true. But we em-
phatically think not. In other words we dis-
agree violently.
We have read the views of the President
as recorded in the newsreel and we find them
an inspiring enunciation of the principles for
which every good American ought to stand.
President Roosevelt should be heard in
Shanghai by the one most potent proxy for
his actual physical presence which science has
yet devised—the cinema screen. But unfort-
unately science has not as yet devised any
means of curing a hedging official timidity.
page_data.zh:
上海与罗斯福先生

按上海的标准来看，罗斯福总统显然是一个危险人物。

他的个性中一定蕴藏着大量潜在的炸药，他的思想中一定包含一些真正“危险的思想”。

因为我们的警方已禁止在一部新闻片中播放他的镜头，该片显示他在芝加哥就国际趋势发表历史性声明的情景——而美国总领事高思（Gauss）在回应一项请求协助反对这一令在上海的美国人反感的决定时，答复称他觉得自己无法介入。

总统呼吁和平。也许这被视为具有煽动性。他抨击了国际上的无法无天行为。也许这违反了上海所解释的法律。他表达了其国家对战争的憎恶。也许我们都应该联手压制这类美国观念，尤其是因为这些观念已经邪恶地渗透到了英国和许多其他国家。

这些说法可能都是真的。但我们坚决认为并非如此。换句话说，我们强烈不同意。

我们阅读了新闻片中记录的总统观点，发现这是对每一位优秀的美国人都应坚持的原则的鼓舞人心的阐述。

罗斯福总统的声音应该通过科学迄今为止设计出的、最能替代他实际亲临现场的有效媒介——电影银幕——让上海听到。但不幸的是，科学尚未设计出任何方法来治愈官员们那种瞻前顾后的怯懦。

GAUSS ACCEDES
TO CENSORSHIP

President Raps Reign
Of Terror, Lawless
Aggressions

President Roosevelt may talk in
Chicago but he's out of luck in
Shanghai—at least so far as local
cinema screens are concerned.
Notification has been received by
the China distributors for Twen-
tieth Century-Fox, Fed. Inc.
U. S. A. that in the opinion of the
local powers that be it is deemed
best to "omit" the newsreel short
of the President's important in-
ternational utterance at Chicago
recently.
What is more, an appeal to the
American Consul-General brought
reply that "Mr. Gauss does not feel
that he can intervene in this
particular case, in view of the local
situation."

Not Advisable
The police made their ruling
"owing to the local situation,"
an official voicing the view that
"I do not consider it advisable to
give local prominence to the Pre-
sident's speech as recorded in
Movietone News Volume 20. The
subject dealt with is one having
deep local significance and is best
omitted at this time."
Those who have viewed the film
are at a loss to see why the Pre-
sident's words, voicing an appeal
for the peace of the world, should
impress the authorities as dange-
rous; nor is it clear why the Am-
erican Consulate-General takes a
hands-off attitude on a matter of
moment to Americans both in
Shanghai and at home.

Text Of Remarks
Text of the President's remarks
as recorded in the newsreel fol-
lows:
"The high hopes and aspirations
expressed in the Briand-Kellogg
pact and the hopes of peace thus
raised, have of late given way to a
haunting fear of calamity.
"The present reign of terror and
international lawlessness began a
few years ago. It began through
unjustified interference in the in-
ternal affairs of other nations or
the invasion of alien territory in
violation of treaties. It has now
reached the stage where the very
foundations of civilisation are
seriously threatened. The land-
mark of traditions which have
marked the progress of civilisation
and which mark the condition of
war and order and justification,
are being slowly wiped away,
without a declaration of war and
without warning or justification of
any kind.

Civilians Murdered
Civilians including vast num-
bers of women and children are
being ruthlessly murdered with
bombs from the air. In times of
so called peace, ships are being
attacked sunked by submarines
without cause or notice. Nations
are fomenting and taking sides in
civil warfare in nations that
have never done them any harm.
"If those things come to pass in
other parts of the world, let no one
imagine that America will escape,
that America may expect mercy,
that this western hemisphere will
not be attacked, and that it will
continue thankfully and peace-
fully to carry on the ethics of the
arts of civilization. The peace lov-
ing nations must make a concerted
effort in opposition to those violat-
ing these national treaties and
those ignoring the humane instinct
which today are creating a state of
international anarchy, interna-
tional instability from which
there is no escape through mere
isolation or neutrality.

"It is my determination to pur-
sue a policy of peace. It is my
determination to adopt every
practicable measure to avoid in-
volvement in war. It ought to be
inconceivable that in this modern
era and in the face of experience
any nation could be so foolish and
ruthless as to run the risk to

高思屈从于审查制度

总统谴责恐怖统治、
无法无天的侵略行为

罗斯福总统可以在芝加哥讲话，但在上海却运气不佳——至少就当地电影银幕而言是这样。

二十世纪福克斯公司（Twentieth Century-Fox）驻中国分销商 Fed. Inc. U. S. A. 已收到通知，称当地当权者认为，最好“省略”最近总统在芝加哥发表的重要国际讲话的新闻短片。

此外，向美国总领事提出的上诉得到的回复是：“鉴于当地局势，高思先生觉得他不能在此特定案件中进行干预。”

不宜公开

警方作出裁决是“鉴于当地局势”，一位官员表达了这样的观点：“我认为不宜让总统在《莫维通新闻》（Movietone News）第20卷中记录的讲话在当地引起广泛关注。所涉主题具有深刻的本地意义，目前最好予以省略。”

看过这部影片的人都不明白，为什么总统表达世界和平呼吁的话语会让当局感到危险；也不清楚为什么美国总领事馆对这件对在上海和在美国本土的美国人都有重大意义的事情采取袖手旁观的态度。

讲话全文

新闻片中记录的总统讲话全文如下：

“《白里安-凯洛格公约》（Briand-Kellogg pact）中所表达的高度希望和愿望，以及由此产生的和平希望，最近已让位于一种挥之不去的灾难恐惧感。

“目前的恐怖统治和国际无法无天状态始于几年前。它始于对他国内政的无理干涉，或违反条约入侵他国领土。现在已达到文明基础受到严重威胁的阶段。标志着文明进步、以及标志着战争、秩序和正当性状况的传统里程碑，正被慢慢抹去，既没有宣战，也没有任何形式的警告或正当理由。

平民遭屠杀

包括大量妇女和儿童在内的平民正遭到空中炸弹的无情屠杀。在所谓的和平时期，船只在毫无原因或通知的情况下遭到潜艇攻击并沉没。一些国家正在那些从未伤害过它们的国家中煽动内战并选边站队。

“如果这些事情在世界其他地区发生，不要以为美国能够幸免，不要以为美国可以期待怜悯，不要以为西半球不会受到攻击，也不要以为它将继续感激且和平地维持文明艺术的伦理。热爱和平的国家必须共同努力，反对那些违反国家条约、无视人道本能的行为，这些行为今天正在造成一种国际无政府状态和国际不稳定局面，而仅仅通过孤立或中立是无法从中逃脱的。

和平政策

“我决心奉行和平政策。我决心采取一切可行措施以避免卷入战争。在这个现代时代，面对经验教训，任何国家竟然如此愚蠢和残忍，冒着通过入侵和违反条约侵犯其他并未对其造成真正伤害且太弱而无法充分自卫的国家的领土，从而将整个世界拖入战争的风险，这应该是不可想象的。然而，世界和平以及包括我国在内的每个国家的福利和安全，今天正受到这种行为的威胁。

“如果我们决心不卷入战争，但我们无法确保自己免受战争的灾难性后果和卷入的危险。美国厌恶战争，美国希望和平，因此，美国积极参与寻求和平。”
